simple.summary: רָתַק (râthaq) means to fasten First listed occurrence: Eccl 12 6.

definitions.full: H7576. rathaq [ רָתַק ] verb bind (Arabic close up and repair, sew up ; Talmud רִיתְקָא fenced enclosure ); — Pu`al Perfect 3plural בַזִּקִּים רֻתְּקוּ Nahum 3:10 her great ones were bound with fetters Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular יֵרָתֵק Eccl 12:6 Qr ( ירחק Kt), from context = be snapped, broken ; read probably יִנָּתֵק (Pfannkuche Thes and modern).
